title: Unga Bunga
description: A new oonga ore, that can be smelted into oonga ingots. A new oonga pickaxe, that can be crafted from oonga ingots. A new underground biome and a new mob.
body:
Was made with MCreator. This is my first mod.

The new oonga ingots smelt way slower than normal.The new mob can be obtained in survival by trading with villagers.If you are in creative,give yourself the ore with commands.
